questions.question: What is the name of the governing body for Kho-Kho in India? a). Kho-Kho Association of India b). Kho-Kho Federation of India (KKFI) c). Indian Kho- Kho Organization d). National Kho- Kho Committee / [CO1]

• Central Lane
  • • The central lane runs through the middle of the Kho Kho court.
  • • It divides the court into two equal halves.
  • • Chasers sit alternately on both sides of the central lane.
  • • The active chaser moves along this lane while chasing defenders.
  • • It helps maintain proper movement and direction during the game.
  • • Width of the central lane is 30 cm.

questions.question: What is the area called where the chasing team sits during the game? a). Lobby b). Court c). Central lane d). Sitting box / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Cross Lanes
  • • Cross lanes are drawn perpendicular to the central lane.
  • • They divide the court into separate sections for seated players.
  • • Each cross lane marks the sitting position of a chaser.
  • • They help players maintain proper spacing and order.
  • • The active chaser uses these lanes while giving “Kho” to teammates.
  • • Width of each cross lane is 30 cm.
  • • Distance between two cross lanes is 2.3 meters.

questions.solution_html:
• Sitting Boxes
  • • Sitting boxes are the spaces formed between cross lanes beside the central lane.
  • • Chasers sit in these boxes in alternate directions.
  • • They ensure organized seating arrangement of players.
  • • These boxes help smooth and quick transfer of “Kho” during the game.
  • • Proper sitting positions reduce confusion and improve coordination among players
